about: A server that lets apps use other storage backends through the Amazon S3 API.

prs.title: The Docker image stores file names with accents again
prs.broken: Since version 4.1.0 the Docker image refused every file name with a non-English letter, like café.jpg, while older images stored them fine.
prs.changed: The image now sets a UTF-8 language setting, which the new base image had dropped.
prs.matters: Users can store and list files with any name again.
